## Automatic updates

The Repository Discovery and Safe Forks GitHub Actions workflow regenerates this catalogue from the repositories owned by NayumAhmed after each run. It includes repository links, descriptions, language, licence metadata, star count, update date, and upstream parent for forks.

This is a metadata catalogue, not a security audit. Review each project's source, dependencies, licence obligations, permissions, and release history before running or deploying it.
